text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...! *wheeze*!! Damn it, 
damn it, damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Not enough, not yet... Next time for 
sure...!! *sniff*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――…… So this is the Twinkle Series……!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The run Mr. C.B. showed in her debut race 
sent shockwaves through the stands.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
A... wesome! What was with that totally 
freeform race?!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We might get to witness the birth of a 
Triple Crown Umamusume in person too, huh!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
True, C.B. really is a rare talent! ...But 
we've seen plenty of rare talents before.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Only two have ever managed to become 
Triple Crown Umamusume. Unfortunately, 
it's not something that comes easily.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that makes sense. Out of all the 
people who have tried so far, only two 
have ever made it.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I really want to believe in her. 
In Mr. C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A small, yet unmistakable ripple in the 
Umamusume world... Perhaps that's what 
this debut race turned out to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, as for Mr. C.B., having 
finished her memorable debut race—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Man, that's a steep one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was climbing a mountain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being right after her memorable 
debut race, as soon as she left the track, 
she declared, "I'm going to the 
mountains," and started climbing as if it 
were the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still... are you really coming along? I'm 
just gonna wander wherever I feel like, 
you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, it's not far from the academy, so 
there shouldn't be any problem leaving her 
alone for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if she went out of her way to 
stop by at a time like this, it must be a 
special place to her."
choice_data_list:
If you're okay with it, I want to go with 
you.

If you're okay with it, I want to go with 
you

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. If that's what you want, 
go right ahead. Just don't get separated!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, feeling somewhat nervous, I 
followed behind her for several hours――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: One Hachimi, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was buying a honey drink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We never made it to the summit. She 
abruptly turned around midway up the 
mountain and headed back down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Trainer? Ah, do you want a 
drink too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From the looks of it, she genuinely 
doesn't understand why everyone is so 
bewildered."
choice_data_list:
...Why come down from the mountain all of 
a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ? Because I got bored!
choice_data_list: I thought you were headed somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, nowhere in particular. I just thought 
it would be nice to take in the panoramic 
view from the mountaintop.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...By the way, I got the Hachimitsu 
Drink just because I felt like drinking 
it—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I think I'd like to go to the 
riverbank. I'm in the mood to watch the 
water surface glisten at dusk."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah... did you think there was something 
special waiting where I was going?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see. Sorry, sorry, I was just out on a 
walk. It's part of my daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If there's a destination at the end of 
where I start walking, it'd be home, my 
parents' place... or maybe the racetrack. 
You'd best remember that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. is a free spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having spent some time together, I thought 
I understood her, but... she seems far 
more whimsical than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of restricting your 
actions. That said, given the future 
ahead, I'd like to be able to anticipate 
things to some degree. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You want to come with me on my walk? Why?
choice_data_list: I want to understand you better.
I want to understand you better.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ......Understanding? From a walk?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By spending time with her and seeing the 
same sights, perhaps I can understand her 
more deeply. That was what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yeah, I see. Hmmm...
choice_data_list: Of course, if you don't want to, I won't.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's alright. Just, promise me one 
thing, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You are strictly forbidden from chiming 
in. You just follow behind me. A stroll is 
no fun if you aren't totally free, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was able to secure a promise to 
accompany Mr. C.B. on her walk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion! New equipment has 
arrived, so I came to notify you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right! I wanna do some 
strength training tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please make good use of it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... Um, have you 
decided on our next race yet?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I went to see it. Your debut 
race yesterday. It was wonderful, and I 
can't wait to see what you do next, or 
something like that... Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san is in an unusually good mood. 
It seems that debut race really resonated 
with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of our next target race... Come 
to think of it, we haven't decided yet. I 
wonder what Mr. C.B. thinks.
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Mr. C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really care about the race 
name, but I'd love one with strong girls 
in it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, that would mean the Asahi 
Hai Futurity Stakes, which decides the 
Junior Class champion, or—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Or the Kyodo News Hai, often called the 
prelude to the spring Classic races, would 
be a good choice... I told her."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then maybe the Kyodo News Hai. I'd 
like a lineup that's hungry for the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I have a lot of fond memories of 
that race too. I'm really looking forward 
to seeing you in action!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while deepening my understanding 
of her, our days of training toward the 
upcoming Kyodo News Service Hai began.
